entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, seeking anticipatory bail arising out of Criminal Case No.2121/2023 from the Court of JMFC registered at Police Station Waidhan, District Singrauli for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 471 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant was only the witness in the sale-deed and no additional role has been assigned to this applicant.
The seller has been granted the anticipatory bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court.
The applicant has falsely been implicated in the case, hence, the applicant be given the benefit of anticipatory bail.

3. Learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the anticipatory bail application and has submitted that the applicant is the main NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:76 2 MCRC-18410-2025 offender and with the collusion with the other co-accused persons, has sold and received the consideration amount, hence, the applicant is not entitled to be released on anticipatory bail.
4.
Heard the parties and perused the case diary.

5. The role of this applicant has been stated to be a witness of the sale- deed and the seller, Nandlal,
Mahesh Kumar, Ramesh Kumar, Angadlal and Sundarlal in which Mahesh Prasad Shah and others have been granted the anticipatory bail by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in M.Cr.C.
No.13825/2024 vide order dated 30.07.2024.

sentences.text: Looking to the factual aspects, this Court deems it appropriate to allow the anticipatory bail application.
Thus, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

7 . It is directed that in the event of arrest the applicant shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer for his appearance before it during the course of investigation or before the trial Court concerned during trial, as the case may be.

8. Applicant is directed to cooperate with the investigating agency and shall also appear on the date and time, as directed by the Investigating Officer and shall also give his specimen signature and finger print samples.

9 . It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by all the conditions as enumerated under Section 482(2) of BNSS.
10.
Accordingly, the application stands disposed of.
